texts.en: Success! The technology and knowledge we sowed into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society has flourished, greatly advancing their civilization from within. Only time will tell what long-term impacts this may have, but for now our operatives report a great deal of good will and prosperity down on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName].
